data.description:
Delete all simulation mode code. The app should only run in live mode connected to the WebSocket server.

Files to modify:
- src/App.jsx: Remove liveMode toggle, always use liveState, remove sim references
- src/hooks/useOfficeState.js: Remove or simplify - simulation code no longer needed
- src/hooks/useGameLoop.js: Can be removed if not used elsewhere
- Keep useLiveMode.js as the primary state source

The app should auto-connect to the WebSocket server on load.

Live mode agents currently receive plain objects from the server (EventStore). They don't have getPosition(), getSprite(), expressions, or animation offsets - they render as static sprites.

Solution: Add client-side animation/interpolation for live mode agents.

Approach:
1. In OfficeCanvas or a new hook, track previous agent positions and interpolate between them for smooth movement
2. Add expression-based animation offsets (bounce, float, etc.) based on agent.state
3. Make getSprite() work for plain objects by looking up SPRITES[agent.role]
4. Add blinking and other visual effects client-side

Key issue: OfficeCanvas branches on `typeof agent.getPosition === 'function'`. For live mode, we need the plain-object branch to also support animations.

Overall polish of the pixel office visualization.

Areas to improve:
- Agent movement in live mode should look natural (not teleporting)
- Message particles should animate smoothly between agents
- UI polish: better chat panel, stats, agent list
- Any canvas rendering bugs
- Color palette consistency
- Performance: canvas re-renders efficiently
